english.title: Engage in / agreed to engage in bookmaking / gaming / wagering or pay / receive / settle bets at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the prior permission of the Airport Company

(A)_[engaged in bookmaking]_
(B)_[engaged in gaming]_
(C)_[engaged in betting or engaged in wagering]_
(D)_[agreed to engage in bookmaking]_
(E)_[agreed to engage in gaming]_
(F)_[agreed to engage in betting or wagering]_
(G)_[paid bets to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER PERSON..),]_
(H)_[received bets from another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER PERSON..),]_
(I)_[settled bets with another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER PERSON..),]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Stansted Airport London
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(16) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
